text.en: I cook our meals at home. Yesterday I ate rice, dal and vegetables. I usually have oats for breakfast. I prefer tea and drink about two litres of water daily.
I usually sleep about seven hours. Last night I slept seven hours and woke feeling rested.
I live with my family and take the bus to work. I leave at eight, start teaching at nine and finish at four.
I feel a little worried about this problem. I enjoy reading novels and gardening to relax.
I walk to the market most days and do no other regular exercise. I have a dog named Milo. Last weekend I visited my parents. I have not travelled recently. Before coming here I was reading a book.
